verdict.rationale: Asana markets natural-language-driven AI features (Dash as an 'AI Chief of Staff', AI Teammates, AI Studio) and has an official MCP server that lets AI agents/assistants issue natural-language commands against Asana data, which directly supports this story. However, all evidence is first-party marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on confirmation that these NL interactions actually work reliably, and details on command scope/limitations are thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of NL command execution, concrete examples of commands and outcomes, and clarity on feature maturity/rollout.
